forecast-period.text: A trough extends over central Australia. A strong high pressure system extends a ridge across southern SA this weekend and pushes the trough into northern SA. The high moves into the Tasman Sea early next week, with the trough shifting west towards the WA border.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Isolated showers and possible thunderstorms in the south and in the far west. Isolated dry thunderstorms are also possible about the Flinders and southern parts of the Pastoral districts. Maximum temperatures near average about coastal districts but well above average inland. East to northeasterly winds in the north, tending south to southeasterly in the south, fresh near the coast.
Isolated showers and thunderstorms in the south and west. Northeast to northwesterly winds, turning southwest to southeasterly about western and southern districts.

Possible early shower about the southern coast, clearing during the late morning. Chance of a thunderstorm in the far northwest. Maximum temperatures near or slightly below average about the southern agricultural area but above average elsewhere. Southeasterly winds in the south, fresh at times near the coast, tending east to northeasterly in the north.

Mostly dry, with isolated showers and thunderstorms developing in the far west during the late afternoon. Maximum temperatures above to well above average. East to northeasterly winds, fresh in the north.

text.p: Isolated showers and thunderstorms in the far west, extending east into central districts during the day. Maximum temperatures well above average. Northeast to northwesterly winds, fresh in the north.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Tuesday: Dry in the northeast. Generally less than 2 mm elsewhere, increasing to 2 to 10 mm about southern coastal districts. Isolated falls of 10 to 20 mm are possible about the west, Kangaroo Island, Flinders Ranges and the southeast.
